data.text: Luke, I agree with keeping our total catch at 50 tons, but why should three of us take less so you and John can take more? I propose 10 tons each this month, leaving 50 to replenish the lake to 100. That gives each family $10,000 a month without sacrificing future catches. I’m willing to stick to 10 if we all agree, and we can review everyone’s catches together afterward. John, would you support equal shares?
